inputs.text:
Look at what we are facing right now. On Wednesday night, Phoenix city leaders approved a dangerous new plan that slaps restrictive handcuffs on ICE and other federal law enforcement agencies, barring them from properly utilizing city property. 

As FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports, these local officials are actively scheming to obstruct federal immigration enforcement. By choosing to protect open borders over public safety and national sovereignty, they are abandoning their duty to the community and coddling lawlessness. It is driven entirely by radical municipal politicians who care more about progressive ideology than the safety of hardworking citizens, putting fringe politics ahead of the rule of law and the families who expect their leaders to uphold traditional order. This is a total collapse of basic order right in our own backyard, and it is an absolute disgrace.
